title: Bronze Rewards Card: Monthly Reporting Tools and Transaction Tracking
summary: This document explains how to use the Bronze Rewards Card monthly transaction reporting tools: view month-to-date spending by merchant/category, drill into transactions (date, merchant descriptor, posted amount), add notes/tags, and export monthly activity to CSV or PDF. It also covers accessing reports (online account → Reports/Statements → select month → apply filters → download), best-practice reconciliation and tagging, and troubleshooting for unfamiliar or missing transactions (check merchant descriptor/posted date; pending items appear only after posting).
